title: Volunteer Capacity & Ministry Coverage
purpose: Canonical structured data and rendering instructions for a two-pane infographic. Never infer values from the appearance of an image.
units: One block represents one volunteer commitment or one ministry staffing position.

people.heading: People

definitions.committed: Number of commitments recorded for the volunteer in this period.
definitions.planned: Planned commitment capacity for the volunteer in this period.

people.display_order: Row-major, two columns: James/Michael, David/Robert, Sarah/Emily, Rachel/Anna, Grace/Daniel. Show ratio immediately after each name, never right-justified.

ministries.heading: Ministries

definitions.target: Desired staffing level, at least minimum.
definitions.assigned: Total volunteer assignments to this ministry in this period.

ministries.block_order: Brown minimum-covered blocks, then gold above-minimum blocks, then gray unmet-need blocks if assigned is below target; green beyond-target blocks follow the covered target when assigned exceeds target.

layout.legends: Two separate legends below their respective panes, aligned at the same vertical starting position.
layout.subtitle: TWO-WEEK PERIOD · ILLUSTRATIVE ASSIGNMENTS
layout.style: Refined dashboard infographic with cream People pane, pale-blue Ministries pane, rounded cards, readable labels and discrete colored square blocks.

integrity_notes: This is a conceptual sketch. Volunteer committed totals and ministry assignments are not yet reconciled.
Sarah has 3 committed and 2 planned. Render two brown blocks and one red block; do not increase her planned capacity.

Current illustrative assignment detail sums to 18, matching the 18 total people commitments, and the per-person totals also match. Preserve the conceptual-sketch disclaimer until the underlying plan is confirmed.
Never change numeric data to make a graphic look balanced. Always derive block counts from the formulas.
Do not interpret a ministry gray block as available volunteer capacity. It means unmet ministry target. A people gray block means unconsumed planned capacity.
